mapper.select: SELECT administrative.administrative_provinces.country_code, administrative.administrative_provinces.province_code, administrative.administrative_provinces.province_name FROM administrative.administrative_provinces WHERE administrative.administrative_provinces.country_code = #{countryCode} ORDER BY administrative.administrative_provinces.province_name

SELECT administrative.administrative_boundaries_by_province.province_code, administrative.administrative_boundaries_by_province.id, administrative.administrative_boundaries_by_province.osm_id, administrative.administrative_boundaries_by_province.name, administrative.administrative_boundaries_by_province.name_en, administrative.administrative_boundaries_by_province.boundary, administrative.administrative_boundaries_by_province.admin_level, administrative.administrative_boundaries_by_province.country_code,
administrative.administrative_boundaries_by_province.label_node_id, administrative.administrative_boundaries_by_province.label_node_lat, administrative.administrative_boundaries_by_province.label_node_lng, administrative.administrative_boundary_centers_by_province.longitude, administrative.administrative_boundary_centers_by_province.latitude FROM administrative.administrative_boundaries_by_province JOIN administrative.administrative_boundary_centers_by_province ON administrative.administrative_boundary_centers_by_province.province_code = administrative.administrative_boundaries_by_province.province_code AND administrative.administrative_boundary_centers_by_province.osm_id = administrative.administrative_boundaries_by_province.osm_id WHERE administrative.administrative_boundaries_by_province.province_code = #{provinceCode} ORDER BY administrative.administrative_boundaries_by_province.name

SELECT province_code AS provinceCode, province_name AS provinceName, country_code AS countryCode, district_code AS districtCode, name, name_en AS nameEn, admin_level AS adminLevel, osm_id AS osmId
FROM administrative.administrative_districts WHERE province_code = #{provinceCode} ORDER BY name ASC
mapper.sql: WITH p AS ( SELECT #{districtCode}::text AS district_code, (split_part(#{districtCode}, '-', 1) || '-' || split_part(#{districtCode}, '-', 2))::text AS province_code )
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM p JOIN administrative.administrative_boundaries_by_province b ON b.province_code = p.province_code JOIN administrative.administrative_boundary_centers_by_province c ON c.province_code = b.province_code AND c.osm_id = b.osm_id WHERE b.district_code = p.district_code AND b.admin_level = 8

SELECT b.province_code AS provinceCode, b.id AS id, b.osm_id AS osmId, b.name AS name, b.name_en AS nameEn, b.boundary AS boundary, b.admin_level AS adminLevel, b.country_code AS countryCode, c.longitude AS longitude, c.latitude AS latitude FROM p JOIN administrative.administrative_boundaries_by_province b ON b.province_code = p.province_code JOIN administrative.administrative_boundary_centers_by_province c ON c.province_code = b.province_code AND c.osm_id = b.osm_id WHERE b.district_code = p.district_code AND b.admin_level = 8 ORDER BY b.name ASC
